evidencePolicy.governingRule: Family membership never grants geometry, registration, procedure, configuration, mechanical authority, or runtime admission.
evidencePolicy.unknownRule: A missing value is null and UNPROVEN; it is never copied from a visually similar product.
evidencePolicy.productRule: A publisher product and each exact face retain independent identity even when geometry is later proven reusable.
evidencePolicy.executionRule: Only an explicit GOVERNED targetProfileBinding may enter the universal zeroing capability.
evidencePolicy.geometryReuseRule: A product face may reuse a governed Geometry Authority only when the inventory proves its physical dimensions, grid scale, and aim reference; publisher and representation identity remain separate.
evidencePolicy.knownIdentityRule: A known product or face with an unresolved execution fact is a known authority hold, never an unknown target and never a request for more photograph coverage unless coverage actually failed.
evidencePolicy.shooterStateRule: Runtime admission distinguishes UNKNOWN_TARGET, KNOWN_TARGET_GEOMETRY_AUTHORIZED, KNOWN_TARGET_AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED, and KNOWN_TARGET_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED.

authorizationSweep.decision: No additional physical face in the completed evidence corpus has the complete representation registration, procedure, applicable mechanical authority, and confirmation package required for a new executable binding. scaleProofs.decision: The family authority was extracted once and the Baker specimen now consumes it through a product-specific representation binding. No second publisher face is admitted because the preserved evidence does not prove its exact physical conformance and representation registration.

The 23 x 35 enlarged product cannot inherit the 8.5 x 11 standard face registration.
Standard M16A2 and modern Universal MOA faces use different grids, aim references, registrations and procedure packages.
Matching product purpose and sheet size do not prove exact physical face geometry or registration landmarks.
